analysis: Documentation-only PR. docs/developer/test.md (head lines 45-51, 53-93) adds MiMo FP32 preflight-refusal fixture guidance, requiring MIMO_V26_SERIAL_NATIVE_TESTS=1 and a fixture dir, plus a Startup Performance Recovery test section (calibration, serving-rate, preload scheduling tests). Both are synthetic tests with no model weights, no production credentials or state, and they state that timings prove state transitions only. docs/operations/provider-release.md patch (hunk @@ -14,8 +14,15) moves the prepared version from 0.9.20 to 0.9.21, notes v0.9.20 was published on 2026-10-12, and records an mlx-swift-lm #305 dependency pin. It states that preparation does not tag, register or publish. It describes calibration behavior (startup health-check timings excluded from throughput learning, bounded calibration without a customer job), but this is only a description of an app change in other files not supplied here. No change to authorization, attestation, encryption, TB-002/TB-011 boundaries, release-signing steps, secrets or the registration payload. Release gating (signed tag, trusted master, hash-pinned registration, App Attest qualification) is unchanged. No threat-model updates are needed. Unseen coverage: the Swift calibration code the docs describe is not in this batch. Calibration traffic or throughput-learning changes could affect T-010/T-029 or routing and capacity claims, so a pass over those source files should check that calibration does not bypass final-handoff authorization or leak content.
